latitude.description: The latitude of the place in degrees, based on the convention that use North as positive, South is negative.
latitude.name: latitude

longitude.description: The longitude in degrees, based on the convention use East as positive and West as negative
longitude.name: longitude

plantDistance.description: Distance between plants in a row.
plantDistance.name: plantDistance

rowOrientation.description: Row orientation. 0 is for east-west, 90 is for south-north (rotate counter-clockwise).
rowOrientation.name: rowOrientation

scenario.description: Internal sub-scenario number for configure different simulations
scenario.name: scenario

age_degreeDay.description: Represents the main organ age in terms of effective growing days adjusted for temperature effects.
age_degreeDay.name: age_degreeDay

age_days.description: Represents the organ age in days
age_days.name: age_days

incomingRadiation.description: Rate of solar radiation received per unit area, measured in micromoles of photons per square meter per second.
incomingRadiation.name: incomingRadiation

LAI.description: Leaf Area Index (LAI) of the field.
LAI.name: LAI

fabsPlant.description: Plant-level absorbed total-radiation fraction aggregated into the field-level output.
fabsPlant.name: fabsPlant

fparPlant.description: Plant-level absorbed PAR fraction aggregated into the field-level output.
fparPlant.name: fparPlant

fabsSoil.description: Field-level light condition: fraction of global radiation absorbed by soil represented by the Tile module
fabsSoil.name: fabsSoil

fparSoil.description: Field-level light condition: fraction of PAR absorbed by soil represented by the Tile module
fparSoil.name: fparSoil

fparGround.description: Fraction of PAR penetrated to the ground in the area defined by the row and plant distance. Similar to fparSoil. Depends on whether using shading factor. It is either using the fpar reached to the tile, or estimated by 1 - 1.06*fpar plant
fparGround.name: fparGround

k.description: Light extinction coefficient for Lambert-Beer equation based on fparGround.
k.name: k

k_ground.description: Light extinction coefficient for Lambert-Beer equation based on field base LAI and fparGround
k_ground.name: k_ground

fPARLow.description: Fraction of PAR penetrated to low layer leaves, trunk height to 1/3 of the plant height - trunk height.
fPARLow.name: fPARLow

fPARMid.description: Fraction of PAR penetrated to mid layer leaves, 1/3 to 2/3 of the plant height - trunk height
fPARMid.name: fPARMid

fPARUp.description: Fraction of PAR penetrated to upper layer leaves, 2/3 of the canopy height. to the plant height.
fPARUp.name: fPARUp

plantDensity.description: The plant density of the simulation.
plantDensity.name: plantDensity

simuuid.description: The unique simulation UUID assigned to each simulation run.
